berlin-motorcycle-escapes-m-rkische-schw.story: A proper escape from Berlin motorcycle escapes with roads worth waking up for. A 245 km loop that starts and ends near Buch, about 5 h 07 of riding. The stops in between: Scenic stretch near Werneuchen, near Zossen and Lichtenrade. in Grünheide is the high point. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

berlin-motorcycle-escapes-m-rkische-schw.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: This Scenic stretch near Werneuchen → High point in Grünheide stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Photo stop near Zossen → Lichtenrade is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

scenicChapters.title: Bieszczady Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 26 km this is Bieszczady Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-uzhok-tserkva-of-the-synaxis-of-t.story: On the way it passes Matkiv-Tserkva of the Synaxis of the Bless, Border Ridge and Gorna Solinka valley, Havešová Primeval Forest and back through Border Ridge and Gorna Solinka valley. The highest point is about 800 m. It crosses Ukraine, Poland and Slovakia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. Much of it runs through woodland.
